scope: New seven-node physical fork simulation demonstration. Graph snapshots come from the frozen pixel/ACC discovery run; both branch holds and the bell hold are separate physical verifications. Not the paper aggregate or a calibration superiority experiment.
presentation: English-only concise viewing cut. Original contact motion and graph pixels preserved; shortened explanation cards; explicit independent resets retained; long settling intervals labeled 6x. Not a real-time physics claim.
